sections.heading: When to use
sections.text: Use forward converter for 50-200W isolated applications. Transfers energy during switch on-time (unlike flyback which stores energy). Duty cycle limited to D < 0.5 for volt-second balance with reset winding. Turns ratio: Vout = Vin*D/N.

sections.heading: Controller structure
sections.text: Use current-mode control (peak or average) for better transient response. The inner current loop handles the inductor dynamics; the outer voltage loop regulates output. Slope compensation required for D > 0.5 (if using extended duty range).

sections.heading: Constraint
sections.text: The transformer must handle unidirectional flux — add a reset winding or use active clamp. Without reset, the transformer saturates. The reset winding limits D to < 0.5. Active clamp allows D > 0.5 and improves efficiency.

sections.heading: Escalation trigger
sections.text: If forward converter fails transient specs, check: (1) Is the transformer properly reset? (2) Is slope compensation adequate for the duty range? (3) Is the current-loop bandwidth high enough? If all checks pass, consider full-bridge for higher power.
